query_and_return_action.interpretation: Both handlers build a generic property view and dispatch through a virtual method. The query returns a boolean written by that dispatch; the underlying attached-item field and the return action side effect are not named in the available static evidence.

post_office_native_path.item_serialization: The serializer writes HasItem from (item != -2); when present, it writes ItemUniqueID. It also writes CardDesignID; ToNpcUniqueID is in the record-type-1 branch.
post_office_native_path.input_binding: The EventFlow passes TmpMailInstance=cSaveMailUserInfo to DropIntoPostOffice; its native helper passes the current temporary record at context+0x658 to the serializer.
post_office_native_path.limit: The sender serializer confirms an optional item is included in the post-office mail record. It does not prove that receipt awards or changes Friendship, and the live save descriptor for the attachment is unresolved.

attached_present_native_trace.finding: The save/edit flows query for an attached present and can return it to baggage. The send-to-villager flow posts cSaveMailUserInfo through a native serializer that can include an item. No recipient-side Friendship write has been found in the traced path.

villager_generated_mail_eventflows.interpretation: These NNPC EventFlows send mail from a villager to the player (birthday, quest, life-start, and overflow paths); they are separate from player-to-villager post-office letters. Their action configurations do not add Friendship by themselves.

mail_processing.finding: The recipient-side daily mail processor reads Friendship to choose reply mail, but the visible processor has no direct Friendship writer edge. This does not rule out effects inside untraced mail UI/action handlers or attached-present handling.

eventflow_gift_related_actions.claim_limit: These are configured action deltas and native callback forwarding. They do not establish every item-quality formula or that each conditional action occurs in a playthrough.

gift_selection.interpretation: NNPC_Select_Present dispatches by selected item kind into creature, equipment, furniture, tool, and other item subflows. NNPC_Select_Sell_Gift is the villager buying a selected player item; CheckNpcFavorLevel selects configured +1/+2/+3 friendship branches, and the overflow branch sends MAIL_XX_OverFlow by NpcMailSendRandom after those deltas. These are different flows from player letters.

player_letter.finding: The local player-to-villager post-office flow edits and posts a message card after a 200-Bell check; it contains no NpcAddFriendship action. The indexed exact-key friendship writer inventory also identifies no letter-sender callsite.
player_letter.limit: This does not rule out a later Friendship change when a delivered letter or attached present is processed.

query_pseudocode.NpcIsHitByNet: 0x389c50 returns case 0 when the NPC hit-by-net byte is nonzero.

timer_and_clear_pseudocode.NpcSetHitTimer: Action handler 0x25c650 stores Timer * 30 at context offset +0xacac; Timer=60 is configured on the below-threshold return path.
timer_and_clear_pseudocode.NpcClearHitParam: Action handler 0x258b10 zeros the u32 at context offset +0xaca8 (the counter read by 0x388660) and byte +0xacb1.

native_controlled_test.finding: The original handler writes Timer * 30 to NPC actor+0xacac.
native_controlled_test.limit: The context and NPC are synthetic; this proves native scaling only. The update-dispatch interval, per-second cadence, and net-hit counter incrementer are not established.

countdown_method.operation: Pseudocode decrements +0xacac once when this actor-update method reaches its timer branch; one call is one decrement, independent of Timer parameter scaling.
countdown_method.invocation_frequency: Not established: runtime dispatch cadence/frame interval is absent from the available static call/pointer-array evidence.

timer_and_clear_pseudocode.flag_offset_caveat: NpcIsHitByNet 0x389c50 reads byte +0xacb0; NpcClearHitParam clears adjacent byte +0xacb1. These are distinct offsets and the evidence does not equate them.
timer_and_clear_pseudocode.counter_increment_search: The available decomp and analysis_decomp corpus exposes the +0xaca8 clear and NpcHitNum read, but no counter increment write. This bounded corpus search is not proof that no indirect or un-decompiled writer exists.
timer_and_clear_pseudocode.limit: The native test proves Timer*30 storage in a synthetic context; static update pseudocode bounds countdown to one unit per eligible method invocation. The real update dispatch rate and the hit-counter incrementer remain unknown, so exact seconds, hits-per-window, and hits-per-day are not established.

net_hits.finding: The net-hit path requires the hit-by-net query to pass and the hit counter to reach 3; the below-threshold path arms the 60-timer action and returns to the normal AI route. Outdoor additionally requires HitMainPlayer and HasAcquaintanceship before entering cHit/Hit. NNPC_Talk_Force:Hit then chooses one of three mutually exclusive random branches; only action sites 21, 32, or 33 can subtract -3, and each is reached through CheckNpcLook case 0 and NoAcquaintance_Chk. The helper exits when HasAcquaintanceship is OFF. Thus one Hit-entry invocation can execute at most one of these three -3 actions, while a later thresholded hit sequence may repeat it after hit state is reset. The same flow has four other -3 actions in Push and +5 in Flea; these are separate entries. All configured callback values are forwarded unchanged in the 72/72 native action test.
limits: The AI transition bodies are not exercised as an end-to-end native hit simulation.
The timer handler is tested natively with synthetic context; update cadence and the counter incrementer remain unknown.
A net hit alone does not prove a Friendship loss: the threshold, AI route, acquaintance/look checks, and selected dialogue branch all matter.

neglect_and_caps.first_talk_of_day: 0xc84240 increments TalkCountToday and awards Friendship only when its resulting value is 1; the delta is min(ContinuousTalkDays, 3), as pseudocode evidence.
neglect_and_caps.missed_talk: The day-change reset helpers clear ContinuousTalkDays when the prior TalkCountToday is zero in the applicable mode. This removes the streak bonus; no direct Friendship decrement is shown on that path.
neglect_and_caps.field_table: EventFlagsNpcMemoryParam sets Friendship default 25/max 255 and ContinuousTalkDays default 0/max 7. These are field bounds, not an aggregate daily Friendship cap.
neglect_and_caps.milestone_flag: NNPC_Talk_General:PresentAvailable_Chk uses FriendshipBecomeAcqHToday and FriendshipBecomeAcqH to gate ReceivedFirstPresent; these flags are not a writer-level point cap.
neglect_and_caps.quest_timeout: NNPC_Quest_Delivery_TimeOver configures -1, -2, or -3 according to HasDeliveryItem and HasOpenedDeliveryItem query branches; this is a quest timeout penalty, not passive neglect decay.

calc_minus_three_branches: First conditional return stores -3 after an opaque date/task helper result check.
Second conditional return stores -3 if any of six opaque key/property lookups (0x3a, 0x62, 0x65, 0x5f, 0x31, 0x2a) reports the guarded condition.
daily_candidate.other_caller_caveat: 0xac0200 also has direct caller 0xabfcf0; that function has no indexed direct caller, so the writer is not proven to be day-change-exclusive.

bounded_native_run_attempt.setup: Executed 0xab9dc0 from the matching main.nso with synthetic output/input buffers and controlled date conversion/range helpers.
bounded_native_run_attempt.stop: The path reached an uninitialized manager/task object access at PC 0x22019d8 before either -3 assignment.
bounded_native_run_attempt.interpretation: No candidate branch was exercised; this is not negative evidence about the -3 result.

daily_candidate.status: Static candidate only. No controlled execution with live manager/save/table dependencies and no ordinary-day occurrence evidence.
daily_candidate.finding: This candidate is separate from the net-hit EventFlow and quest-timeout penalties; it cannot yet be labelled normal daily decay.

neglect_and_caps.aggregate_cap_evidence: The full indexed EventFlow action inventory contains 72 configured AddFriendship values, all forwarded unchanged at 0xd34cb0; the generic writer clamps an individual value against its supplied descriptor but has no visible daily accumulator/gate. The Friendship table row sets DefaultValue=25 and MaxValue=255. No aggregate day-total field or writer-side daily cap is identified in this direct-call/string-reference inventory.
neglect_and_caps.finding: The evidence supports a per-source first-talk limit of one reward/day and a byte ceiling of 255, but does not establish a universal daily point cap. No-talk streak loss is documented separately from Friendship decay. The negative result is bounded to indexed direct writers and EventFlows in this 1.0.0 main build; indirect writes, dynamic keys, and absent modules remain possible.
